summary: Wave 5 leads with auth-exploit (CORS null-origin PoC). All other exploits are gated on getting a session from chain_002. Dispatch auth-exploit first, then remaining exploits in parallel with session hints.

objectives.description: Execute CORS null-origin exploit and obtain authenticated session token
objectives.success_criteria: Working PoC HTML that steals session token cross-origin via null iframe

objectives.description: Use authenticated session to test SSRF to Azure IMDS
objectives.success_criteria: IMDS response or managed identity token retrieved

objectives.description: Use authenticated session to test RBAC IDOR privilege escalation
objectives.success_criteria: Can change own role to admin or read other users data

hints.expected_outcome: Working CORS null-origin exploit PoC HTML file that reads authenticated API response
hints.technique: sandboxed iframe with sandbox='allow-scripts' to force null origin, fetch /auth/me with credentials:include, read response body cross-origin due to CORS misconfiguration
hints.secondary_path: OIDC nonce absence (chain_003) — if CORS PoC blocked, test nonce replay with attacker-controlled Azure AD app

hints.expected_outcome: With authenticated session, probe SSRF endpoints for Azure IMDS access
With auth session, test RBAC IDOR to change own role or access other users data
test_vectors: horizontal user data access via ID iteration

hints.expected_outcome: With auth, run GraphQL introspection and test for privileged mutations
With auth, test SQL injection in query params
test_vectors: time-based blind SQLi on filter params

hints.expected_outcome: With auth, enumerate Pusher channels and test data exfil
test_vectors: subscribe to private-* channels not belonging to own user
presence channel enumeration for user list disclosure

deprioritize.reason: No XSS found in Wave 4, Vercel bot protection active, low value to pursue

dispatch_order.phase_2_gate: auth-exploit must produce session token before phase_2 dispatch

stats.highest_impact_outcome: Azure IMDS managed identity token via CORS→auth→SSRF chain
